what_you_believe_happened: Signed in as manager.audit. The landing screen was a chat with the assistant. I typed 'Which Kapoor Villa tasks are still open and who has them?' and pressed Enter. The assistant replied with a table (title, assignee, due date, status, progress): 'Order tiles for master bath' - Arjun Architect - 2026-12-05 - open - 0; 'Pour first-floor slab' - Sanjay Site - 2026-12-05 - open - 0.
confusing_terminology: Show as chart or save -> unclear what 'save' saves or where
missing_feedback: No visible loading indicator was checked; reply appeared within 5s
Reply does not restate which project it filtered on, so I cannot confirm from the screen that the rows are only Kapoor Villa
visual_issues: Table column headers are lowercase raw field names (title, assignee, due date); progress shows bare 0 with no unit
Send button is grey even when text was entered (not checked after typing)
accessibility_issues: Microphone and plus icons have no visible text labels
observations: Very discoverable: the first screen is the assistant, with a greeting and suggestion chips. Answer was immediate and readable. Caveat: the table has no project column, so the Kapoor Villa scoping is not verifiable from the output.
